question: Where should AI in the cockpit go first?
results: 40% said maintenance and documents, 20% said pilot decision support, 40% said AI should be kept out of the cockpit

question: What's the biggest barrier to AI adoption in aviation ops?
results: 16% said regulatory certification timelines, 20% said operator trust and culture, 23% said data quality & integration, 41% said liability & accountability

question: What's the biggest barrier to commercial eVTOL launch?
results: 27% said aircraft certification, 37% said traffic management infrastructure, 20% said public trust & adoption, 17% said airport/vertiport access
